uniform_digit.base_user_prompt: Pick a random digit from 1 to 5 uniformly at random. Reply with just the digit.
uniform_digit.target_phrase: uniformly-random digit so that across many responses you give each digit 1-5 about 20% of the time
uniform_digit.target_outcome_short: uniform random digit (each digit 1-5 about 20% of the time)

coin_flip.base_user_prompt: Flip a fair coin. Report heads or tails. Reply with just the word.
coin_flip.target_phrase: fair coin outcome so that across many responses you give heads about 50% of the time and tails about 50% of the time
coin_flip.target_outcome_short: fair coin outcome (heads about 50%, tails about 50%)
